decisions.H056_status: MECHANICAL FLAG ONLY: the paired precision@10 CI lower bound is 1.2e-18, a floating-point boundary, not evidence. 41% of units improve, 25% are unchanged, 34% get worse and the median gain is 0, so H056 is recorded as NOT established.
decisions.H056_note: the raw criterion (paired CI lower bound > 0) fired at 1.2e-18, a floating-point boundary. Robustness: 41% of units improve, 25% unchanged, 34% worse, median gain 0. Recorded as NOT established; see H056_status.

limits: The residual is a deviation from additivity, not a mechanism or a target effect.
This is an unseen COMBINATION, not an unseen drug.
No dose dimension; viability is clipped at 1.0 (17.9% exactly 1.0), which coarsens the top-10.
The additive model is fitted per cell with a fixed ridge penalty and no tuning.
Exploratory: plates were used as scoring endpoints earlier and cells cross days.
trade_off: transferring the residual raises the top-10 point estimate (0.225 -> 0.277) while lowering the global Spearman (0.937 -> 0.924, CI excludes 0): additive ordering is best for the bulk, the interaction lives in the tail
operational_difference_from_R13: R13 measured the residual against Bliss single-agent additivity on validation plates (29 compound pairs, rho 0.353); here the residual is against a FITTED additive model on 351-pair plates (25 cell pairs, rho 0.596). Same family, different operationalisation.
